title: A New Storm
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji stepped into that secret chamber, the countdown to the Seventh Day of the Seventh Month had begun—and the first deadly trap laid by the Heavenly Secrets Eye was what he was about to face.

text.content: The night wind carried a chill, and Chen Ji turned sharply, his gaze like a blade piercing the distant darkness. When he had just left the chamber, that feeling of being watched had clung to him like a bone-deep disease. "Who's there?" His voice was terrifyingly calm, yet in his palm a faint glimmer of spiritual energy had already gathered. However, what answered him was only the mournful wind, as if the entire world was mocking his vigilance.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, you've finally noticed me." The voice didn't come from his ears but exploded directly in his mind, vast, ancient, carrying undeniable majesty. "You think you stole that fragment? No, I gave it to you."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his knuckles white from tension. The voice seemed to surge from all directions, yet also directly carved into the depths of his soul. "Heavenly Secrets Eye..." he murmured, his throat tight. He had seen this name countless times in the fragments of the Tianji Record, but never imagined it would come for him directly. Something churned violently in his chest—rage and terror intertwined.

dialogue.content: "The Seventh Day of the Seventh Month, the third watch of midnight." The voice continued, cold as a death sentence being pronounced. "At that time, you will face your first choice—destroy those you cherish with your own hands, or watch them perish because of your incompetence. Heavenly Fate Value... you think it's your strength, but every time you have foresight, you take one step closer to death."

text.content: Chen Ji's breath quickened. The spiritual light in his palm trembled violently, and he could feel the Heavenly Fate Value inside him stirring restlessly, as if sensing its master's emotional turmoil. The Seventh Day of the Seventh Month—it was precisely the opening day of the Forbidden Grounds he had calculated, a crucial piece in his plans. But now it sounded like not just a time point, but a meticulously designed deadly trap.

dialogue.content: "What do you want?" Chen Ji's voice was low and dangerous, something slowly gathering in his eyes. "Since you've already chosen me as a chess piece, why the unnecessary theatrics? In your eyes, I'm just another pitiful seer, nothing more."

text.content: "Chess piece?" The voice suddenly carried a hint of amusement. "If you were merely a piece, why would I bother appearing in person? Chen Ji, you are more dangerous than any of your predecessors... and far more interesting." Before the words finished, Chen Ji felt his vision darken, and countless images flooded into his mind like a tide—firelight, blood, Su Qingyao's desperate eyes, and the blurry figure of Chen Nian bound in chains.

choice.prompt: The voice of the Heavenly Secrets Eye echoed in his mind, and Chen Ji felt pressure like never before. The image of his sister shook him to his core, but he knew he absolutely could not lose his composure at this moment.

choices.text: Confront directly, question the Heavenly Secrets
choices.description: Directly question the purpose of the Heavenly Secrets Eye, display an unyielding will, and let the other party know he is not a chess piece to be manipulated.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information about the Seventh Day of the Seventh Month
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Secrets Eye may further press its advantage

text.content: "Interesting." Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile cold and sharp. "Heavenly Secrets Eye? Nothing but a coward hiding in the darkness. If you truly had ability, why threaten me with my sister?" The words fell, and he abruptly mobilized the spiritual energy within him, the Heavenly Fate Value surging through his meridians like boiling blood.

choices.text: Endure and lie low, gather intelligence
choices.description: Suppress the burning rage in his heart, pretend nothing happened, and extract more information about the chess game's layout from the other party's words.
choices.risk_hint: May be seen through by the other party

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing the surging emotions back into the depths of his heart. "...What exactly do you want?" His voice regained its calm, even carrying a hint of compliance. The voice in his mind seemed satisfied and hummed: "Smart. Only those who know the times can live long."

Regardless of what attitude he chose, the Heavenly Secrets Eye's voice never stopped: "Before the Seventh Day of the Seventh Month, you still have seven days. Make good use of that Tianji Record Fragment of yours—let's see how many more times it can warn you." Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest, and looking down, he saw a wisp of black energy spreading from his heart—that was the brand of Heavenly Fate, also a shackle.

dialogue.content: "Seven days..." Chen Ji repeated softly, a cold smile suddenly curving his lips. "Enough." He clenched his fist, the black energy hissing between his fingers. "You want to watch a show? Then I'll perform for you. But remember—the boundaries between chess player and chess piece... are sometimes not that clear."

text.content: The moment the words fell, the voice in his mind vanished abruptly, replaced by a wave of violent dizziness. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, cold sweat sliding down his temples. The Heavenly Fate Value was draining frantically from his body—that was the "greeting gift" left by the Heavenly Secrets Eye before departing—five points, all five points. He should have known that every confrontation with this terrifying existence would come at a price.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji knelt in the night, feeling the emptiness of his Heavenly Fate within. He knew his time was running out—he had to make a choice within seven days. In the distance, footsteps seemed to approach—someone had discovered his anomaly.

choices.text: Feign injury to draw out the hidden enemy
choices.description: Deliberately expose the weakened state to see who lurks in the shadows, perhaps dragging out another pawn of the Eyes of Heavenly Secrets.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence on the hidden enemy
choices.risk_hint: If the opponent is too powerful, things may backfire

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered as an idea struck him. He suddenly burst into violent coughing, curling up on the ground with an expression of pain and misery. The footsteps indeed quickened, and in the darkness, a familiar figure hurried over—it was Su Qingyao.

choices.description: Rise through sheer willpower, using the usualtrash posture to cover the刚才 abnormality, leaving no trace for anyone to detect.
choices.visible_cost: Requires extra energy to maintain the disguise
choices.visible_reward: Keep the secret, protect the plan
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may become even more suspicious

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth, suppressing the weakness with extraordinary willpower as he slowly stood. He brushed dust from his robes, his face resuming its wooden, timid expression, as if the刚才 had merely been a slip while walking at night. The footsteps stopped nearby, and Su Qingyao's voice carried a hint of alertness: "Chen Ji? It's late—what are you doing here?"

Su Qingyao's gaze swept over Chen Ji, her brow slightly furrowed. As Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, her perception far exceeded ordinary disciples, and she had clearly caught that momentary spiritual energy fluctuation. "You look terrible." She stepped forward, her tone carrying undeniable concern, "Did you mess up another secret cultivation again?"

dialogue.content: "Thank you for your concern, Senior Sister Su." Chen Ji kept his head bowed, his voice barely a whisper, "I've just been sleeping poorly these days... The night is deep and the dew heavy—I should return to rest." With that, he turned to leave, though his steps carried a barely perceptible stumble.

text.content: Su Qingyao blocked his path, her face cold as ice under the moonlight, though a trace of concealed tenderness flickered in her eyes. "The Forbidden Grounds open in seven days." Her voice dropped low, "Chen Ji, I don't know what you're hiding, but I warn you—if you dare do anything against the sect, I, Su Qingyao, will be the first to stop you."

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's warning echoed in the night wind, and Chen Ji sensed the complex emotions within her words. As the only one who had noticed the anomaly, her stance left Chen Ji feeling both awkward and... an inexplicable warmth.

choices.text: Appeal to emotions, reveal some truth
choices.description: Reveal partial truth to Su Qingyao, win her trust and assistance to jointly face the crisis in seven days.
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful ally, increase affection
choices.risk_hint: May shake Su Qingyao's loyalty to the sect

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly raised his head, meeting Su Qingyao's gaze directly. That gaze held none of its former timidity—only an unfathomable calm. "Senior Sister Su... In seven days, if I do anything disrespectful, kill me." Su Qingyao froze, momentarily at a loss for words.

choices.description: Continue playing thetrash role, dismiss Su Qingyao with pleasantries, keeping her out of this chess game far beyond her imagination.
choices.visible_cost: Missed the opportunity to recruit allies
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may become even more suspicious and secretly investigate

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, a bitter smile tugging at the corner of his lips. "Senior Sister, you're overthinking it. As a Servant Disciple, how could I possibly have such ability..." His voice returned to its usual timidity, as if that momentary sharpness had been merely Su Qingyao's illusion. As he turned to leave, his back resembled a pitiful wretch crushed by life's burdens.

Su Qingyao gazed at Chen Ji's departing silhouette, her brow furrowing even deeper. Her intuition told her this Servant Disciple was far from ordinary, yet every time she tried to investigate further, the clues would mysteriously vanish. "Chen Ji..." she murmured softly, her palm unconsciously clenching tighter. "Who exactly are you?" The night wind stirred her garments, carrying away the unspoken words she did not say.

Meanwhile, in a concealed cave dwelling deep within the Tianqing Sect. The former Sect Master Ling Yuan abruptly opened his eyes, a sharp gleam flickering in his turbid gaze. "The mark of Heavenly Secrets' Eye..." His voice was hoarse and sinister. "That boy is indeed no simple matter." He raised his hand, tracing a rune in the air, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his lips. "Interesting, very interesting..."

Chen Ji stumbled back to his decrepit hut. The moment he shut the door, he leaned against the wooden boards and let out a long breath. The Heavenly Fate points remaining in his body flickered like a candle in the wind, precarious and unstable. Slowly, he raised his right hand, a faint glow of the Tianji Record Fragment appearing in his palm. "Seven days..." he murmured to himself, a resolute light flashing in his eyes. "In seven days, either you die or I perish."

He walked to the window, gazing at the残月 crescent moon obscured by dark clouds. The seventh day of the seventh month—the starting point of the countdown, and the beginning of his official confrontation with the Heavenly Secrets' Eye. The seal on his chest throbbed with隐隐作痛 pain, the black energy seemingly reminding him—no matter how he struggled, he could never escape fate's grasp. But Chen Ji never believed in destiny. His fists clenched tightly, knuckles cracking. "Chapter 700..." he whispered several words, his tone filled with boundless fury and defiance. "I will not die!" The night wind howled outside the window, as if responding to his vow. A new storm was already approaching.
